title: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi says the company plans to spend $10B+ "over the coming years" to deploy 120K driverless vehicles, aiming to hit 15+ cities in 2026 (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi says the company plans to spend $10B+ “over the coming years” to deploy 120K driverless vehicles, aiming to hit 15+ cities in 2026 — Chief Dara Khosrowshahi lauds strong bookings and record cash flow as company seeks to fund costly AV push
